title: Measurement Set
description: A file set for a distinct measurement, such as the sequencing of a genomic library generated by an experiment performed on a cell line. A measurement set contains the raw data files generated by the measurement.

assay_term.title: Assay Term
assay_term.description: The assay used to produce data in this measurement set.

library_construction_platform.title: Library Construction Platforms
library_construction_platform.description: The platform used to construct the library sequenced in this measurement set.

protocols.title: Protocols
protocols.description: Links to the protocol(s) for conducting the assay

preferred_assay_title.title: Preferred Assay Title
preferred_assay_title.description: The custom lab preferred label for the experiment performed in this measurement set.

multiome_size.title: Multiome Size
multiome_size.description: The number of datasets included in the multiome experiment this measurement set is a part of.

control_file_sets.title: Controls
control_file_sets.description: File sets that can serve as scientific controls for this measurement_set.

items.title: Control
items.description: File sets that can serve as scientific controls for this measurement_set.
items.comment: See fileset.json for a list of available identifiers.

sequencing_library_types.title: Sequencing Library Types
sequencing_library_types.description: Description of the libraries sequenced in this measurement set.

sequencing_chemistry.title: Sequencing Chemistry
sequencing_chemistry.description: The version or type of sequencing chemistry used.

donor_validation_method.title: Donor Validation Methods
donor_validation_method.description: Method used for mapping the data to the donor it came from.

auxiliary_sets.title: Auxiliary Sets
auxiliary_sets.description: The auxiliary sets of files produced alongside raw data from this measurement set.

items.title: Auxiliary Set
items.description: An auxiliary set of files produced alongside raw data from this measurement set.
items.comment: See auxiliary_set.json for a list of available identifiers.

file_set_type.description: The category that best describes this measurement set.
file_set_type.comment: File set type describes the content of the measurement set. Experimental data refers to any data obtained in a genomics assay.

external_image_url.title: External Image URL
external_image_url.description: Links to the external site where images produced by this measurement are stored.

targeted_genes.title: Targeted Genes
targeted_genes.description: A list of genes targeted in this assay. For example, TF ChIP-seq attempts to identify binding sites of a protein encoded by a specific gene. In CRISPR FlowFISH, the modified samples are sorted based on expression of a specific gene. This property differs from small_scale_gene_list in Construct Library Set, which describes genes targeted by the content integrated in the constructs (such as guide RNAs.)

items.title: Gene
items.comment: See gene.json for a list of available identifiers.

islet_purification_method.title: Islet Purification for Functional Assay
islet_purification_method.description: Method used to purify islets before the functional assay (e.g., hand-picking to ensure purity and size consistency)
islet_purification_method.comment: Example value from perifusion metadata: Hand-picked

total_islets_for_assay.title: Total Number of Islets for Functional Assay
total_islets_for_assay.description: Total number of islets loaded into the perifusion chamber or tissue culture well for the functional assay

islet_diameter.title: Islet Size/Diameter (μm)
islet_diameter.description: Average islet diameter calculated as (longest + shortest) / 2 in micrometers

islet_purity_for_assay.title: Islet Purity for Functional Assay (%)
islet_purity_for_assay.description: Percentage of target islet cells in the preparation used for the functional assay

islet_volume_ieq.title: Islet Cell Volume for Functional Assay (IEQ)
islet_volume_ieq.description: Islet cell volume expressed as islet equivalents (IEQ). 1 IEQ = 1 islet with a diameter of 150 μm.

islet_endocrine_composition.title: Islet Endocrine Cell Composition (%)
islet_endocrine_composition.description: Percentage breakdown of endocrine cell types within the islet preparation. See https://www.protocols.io/view/islet-embedding-for-histology-261ge455dv47/v1
islet_endocrine_composition.comment: Example value from perifusion metadata: Beta: 76%; Alpha: 19%; Delta: 5%

perifusion_protocol.title: Perifusion Protocol
perifusion_protocol.description: Link to the protocols.io protocol for the dynamic cell perifusion assay

base_media.title: Base Media
base_media.description: Detailed composition of the perifusion media including supplements and buffering components

submissionExample.appscript: CMRL 1066 supplemented with 0.1% BSA, 10 mM HEPES
submissionExample.igvf_utils: CMRL 1066 supplemented with 0.1% BSA, 10 mM HEPES

stimuli_secretagogues.title: Stimuli or Secretagogues
stimuli_secretagogues.description: JSON object describing the temporal sequence of glucose and pharmacological stimulations during perifusion. Each key is a time range (e.g., '3-9 min') and each value is an array of stimuli applied.
stimuli_secretagogues.comment: Example value from perifusion metadata: {"3-9 min": ["5.6 mM glucose"], "12-39 min": ["16.7 mM glucose"], "42-60 min": ["5.6 mM glucose"], "63-69 min": ["16.7 mM glucose + 100 μM IBMX"]}

submissionExample.appscript: {"3-9 min": ["5.6 mM glucose"], "12-39 min": ["16.7 mM glucose"]}
submissionExample.igvf_utils: {"3-9 min": ["5.6 mM glucose"], "12-39 min": ["16.7 mM glucose"]}

perifusion_flow_rate.title: Perifusion Flow Rate
perifusion_flow_rate.description: Flow rate of media through the perifusion system (e.g., mL/min, μL/min)
perifusion_flow_rate.comment: Example value from perifusion metadata: 1 mL/min

perifusion_fraction_volume.title: Perifusion Fraction Volume
perifusion_fraction_volume.description: Volume of each fraction collected over a defined time interval (e.g., mL, μL)
perifusion_fraction_volume.comment: Example value from perifusion metadata: 3 mL

fraction_collection_time.title: Fraction Collection Time (min)
fraction_collection_time.description: Time interval set on the perifusion fraction collector for each fraction collection
fraction_collection_time.comment: Example value from perifusion metadata: 3 mins

hormone_assays.title: Hormone Assays
hormone_assays.description: Hormones measured in perifusion fractions (e.g., insulin, glucagon). See https://www.protocols.io/view/analysis-of-islet-function-by-insulin-enzyme-linke-bz7bp9in
hormone_assays.comment: Example value from perifusion metadata: Insulin; glucagon

data_url.title: Data URL
data_url.description: Link for downloading the functional assay data (if publicly available)
data_url.comment: Example value from perifusion metadata: https://hipp.coh.org/#/entry/435
